english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a visibly disordered place, arrangement, or situation.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for a visibly messy room or general disorder.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things being messy or in disarray.
Use 亂糟糟 for wild-looking hair, clothing, or surroundings that are messy, tangled, or untidy.
